title: Ensure nodev option set on /tmp partition
objective: Audit CIS checkpoint 1.1.2.1.2: Ensure nodev option set on /tmp partition

parameters.name: fs_option
parameters.description: Filesystem mount option to check on /tmp partition (e.g. nodev, nosuid, noexec)

steps.name: Check if /tmp is a separate partition using command: `findmnt -kn /tmp`. Expecte
steps.function: 1. Check if /tmp is a separate partition using command: `findmnt -kn /tmp`. Expected result: output contains a mount point for /tmp.

steps.name: Check if the nodev option is set on the /tmp partition using command: `findmnt -
steps.function: 2. Check if the nodev option is set on the /tmp partition using command: `findmnt -kn /tmp | grep -v nodev`. Expected result: no output (empty).

steps.name: Check overall compliance status: PASS if the separate partition exists and nodev
steps.function: 3. Check overall compliance status: PASS if the separate partition exists and nodev is set; SKIP if /tmp is not a separate partition; FAIL if /tmp is a separate partition but nodev is not set.
